SELECT A.FINPROD_ID finprodId, A.FINPROD_TYPE finprodType, A.PUBLISH_DATE publishDate, FIN.FINPROD_ABBR finprodAbbr, A.VAL_DATE valDate, A.VALUATION valuation, '' sevenDayRate, B.TYPE_1 type1 FROM FIN_PRODUCT_VALUATION A LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE B ON A.FINPROD_ID =B.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT fin ON A.FINPROD_ID =fin.FINPROD_MARKET_ID WHERE 1=1
AND a.FINPROD_TYPE = #{finprodType}
AND ( A.FINPROD_ID like concat_ws('','%',#{finprodId},'%') or fin.FINPROD_ABBR like concat_ws('','%',#{finprodId},'%') )
AND fin.FINPROD_ABBR like concat_ws('','%',#{fundAbbr},'%')
AND B.TYPE_1 =#{fundtype}
AND A.VAL_DATE >= STR_TO_DATE(#{valuationStartDate},'%Y-%m-%d')
AND A.VAL_DATE <=STR_TO_DATE(#{valuationEndDate},'%Y-%m-%d')
